topPRs.title: mainnet, sepolia: Add OP and Unichain interop dependency set
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
OP Mainnet and Unichain activate Lagoon together, and so do OP Sepolia and Unichain Sepolia. This PR puts each pair in one interop dependency set. Each chain lists both chain IDs under `[interop.dependencies]`.

The dependency set controls the Lagoon activation. op-node and kona add the `setFeature(INTEROP)` deposit and the `ETHLiquidity` funding deposit only when the set has more than one chain. Without this change, nodes and the kona prestate treat each chain as a one-chain set. Lagoon then activates without the interop predeploys.

`check_depsets` passes. `apply-hardforks` and `codegen` produce no other diff.

After `lagoon_time`, `check_depsets` also requires both chains in a set to have the same `DisputeGameFactoryProxy` and `EthLockboxProxy`. The two chains in each pair do not share these addresses yet. So `addresses.json` must get the shared addresses before activation (10 Dec 2026 for Sepolia), or CI fails after that time.
